sources.title: The Discrepancy of Boxes in Higher Dimension
sources.normalized_statement: For d=O(log n), standard box discrepancy can be 2^Omega(d); for d=Omega(log n), it can be n^Omega(1).

sources.title: Lower Bounds in Differential Privacy
sources.normalized_statement: Accurate reconstruction of a large fraction of a private binary database conflicts with differential privacy.

sources.authors: Talya Eden, Quanquan C. Liu, Sofya Raskhodnikova, and Adam Smith
sources.title: Triangle Counting with Local Edge Differential Privacy
sources.normalized_statement: Expected Hamming reconstruction error is at least exp(-epsilon)*(1/2-delta)*N for a uniform binary input.

sources.title: Combinatorial Discrepancy for Boxes via the gamma_2 Norm
sources.normalized_statement: For every fixed d>=2 and infinitely many n, an n-point set has axis-parallel-box discrepancy Omega(log^(d-1) n).

sources.title: Optimal Private Halfspace Counting via Discrepancy
sources.normalized_statement: Lemma 5 sums partial discrepancies over geometric residual sizes; Theorem 3 lower-bounds average squared error for private orthogonal range counting.
